top_signals.title: Gold Edges Higher as Treasuries Stabilize After Sharp Selloff
top_signals.summary: Gold edged higher after touching a more than seven-week low on Monday as a selloff of US Treasuries stabilized, even as expectations remained high the Federal Reserve will keep tightening policy to rein in inflation.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: Copper Edges Higher as Chile Mine Dispute Raises Supply Concerns
top_signals.summary: Copper edged higher as supply concerns came to the fore, with workers at a major operation in Chile voting to strike after talks failed.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: Heathrow’s billionaire bidder: I’ll put every penny I have on more third runway delays
top_signals.summary: The billionaire hotel tycoon behind a rival bid to develop Heathrow’s third runway has said there is “no way” the proposal put forward by the airport’s owner can be delivered on time, even after the megaproject was delayed by four years.
